title: AddNodesRequest
description: The control-command payload for 'add N permanent nodes to this cluster' (#518) — the permanent counterpart to a burst provision request. add_nodes() drives a Provisioner to bring up `count` nodes meeting the per-node capability floor `spec`; each auto-joins via the seed-peer handshake and persists as an ordinary cluster member. Unlike the autoscaler, the add never tears a node down or revokes its identity. Mirrored by zetta::AddNodesRequest in include/zetta/add_nodes.hpp and enforced by AddNodesRequest::from_json() in src/core/add_nodes.cpp — keep them in sync. A malformed command is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured add fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or an unbounded) fleet.

count.description: How many permanent nodes to add. 0 is a satisfied no-op.

spec.description: The per-node capability floor each added node must meet. Optional; absent means the no-floor capability (every node satisfies it). See node_capability.schema.json.

node_capability.description: What an added node must provide — CPU cores, memory, and an optional GPU (type + throughput). Mirrors node_capability.schema.json.

cores.description: Logical CPU cores the node provides.

gpu.description: The node's accelerator. Optional; absent means CPU-only (equivalent to kind 'none').

kind.description: The accelerator family. Append-only enum (the lowercase name is the stored identifier).

throughput_tflops.description: Coarse throughput in teraFLOPS. 0 when there is no GPU.
